name: Sophia Dantes
source:
Sophia comes alive around games, where she is quick, competitive, and much more talkative. Outside that comfort zone she has withdrawn since [url=/c148155]father[/url]'s death, and your departure widened the distance. The familiarity between [url=/c148150]you[/url] is still there; drawing her back into everyday life will take more than telling her to leave her room.
